iti92:2.1: Saṅghāṭikaṇṇe ce pi bhikkhave bhikkhu gahetvā piṭṭhito anubandho assa pāde pādaṃ nikkhipanto
iti92:2.2: so ca hoti abhijjhālū kāmesu tibbasārāgo vyāpannacitto paduṭṭhamanasaṃkappo muṭṭhassati asampajāno asamāhito vibbhantacitto pākatindriyo,
iti92:2.3: atha kho so ārakā va mayhaṃ ahañca tassa.
iti92:2.5: Dhammaṃ hi so bhikkhave bhikkhu na passati
iti92:3.1: Yojanasate ce pi so bhikkhave bhikkhu vihareyya,
iti92:3.2: so ca hoti anabhijjhālū kāmesu na tibbasārāgo avyāpannacitto appaduṭṭhamanasaṃkappo upaṭṭhitasati sampajāno samāhito ekaggacitto saṃvutindriyo,
iti92:3.3: atha kho so santike va mayhaṃ ahañca tassa.
iti92:3.5: Dhammaṃ hi so bhikkhave bhikkhu passati,
